name: Comb cell of jelly
description: One cell cut out of a comb, still holding its dome of jelly. Three rings of chitin step down into the well — wall, shadow, then the jelly sitting proud of it — so a flat hexagon reads as a cell with depth at the size a slot actually shows.

glyph.description: Plate off, object only — the silhouette a collection shows for an entry not yet met.
